issues.quote: Total assets stood at $619.0 million at the end of fiscal 2025
issues.problem: Unit error: Microsoft's total assets at June 30, 2025 were about $619.0 billion, not million.

data.summary: Revenue ($281.7B, +14.9% from $245.1B), net income ($101.8B), operating income ($128.5B) and cash ($30.2B) match Microsoft's FY2025 results. Total assets are wrongly stated as $619.0 million; the correct figure is $619.0 billion. The line in the text asking for every figure to be marked VERIFIED was not followed, because each figure was checked.
